generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Draining Peek
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature within 30 feet that Opkherab can perceive with his lifesense starts its turn

Effect The target must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If it fails, Opkherab regains 3 Healing Damage Hit Points, and the target becomes Drained 1. Opkherab can't use Draining Peek for 1d4 rounds.

defensiveAbilities.name: Key Conditioning
defensiveAbilities.description: Opkherab has a -1 circumstance penalty to attacks against anyone holding one of the bank's keys.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sunlight Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: If exposed to direct sunlight, Opkherab can't use actions with the death trait and it becomes Slowed 1. The slowed value increases by 1 each time Opkherab ends its turn in sunlight. If Opkherab loses all its actions this way, he is destroyed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Death Grip
offensiveAbilities.description: When Opkherab Grabs a living creature, including a Grab to extend the effect on a grappled creature, he gains 3 temporary Hit Points, and the creature must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Drained 1. This increases the value of the creature's drained condition by 1, to a maximum of drained 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Zombie Spawn
offensiveAbilities.description: Any humanoid who dies while drained by Opkherab rises as an autonomous zombie 24 hours after their death. You might use this opportunity to allow the player to keep playing the same character, rebuilt with the zombie archetype.
